correctness.rationale: The posterior under a pooled positive and k negative leaf observations is p/(1-(1-p)^(n-k)); exact Bayes risk improvement yields G_{n,k}. Enumerating every exchangeability class of pairwise submodularity inequalities for n=3 reduces to two second differences D_k and three root-leaf inequalities; algebra gives the necessary and sufficient 1/5 boundary and four-piece λ_c, including exact equality cases and n=2 minimality. A standard-library exact-rational source-state enumerator independently checks every tested subset, the exact 3/200 counterexample, and threshold equalities. Its finite outputs are supporting checks, not the all-real-parameter proof.

value.rationale: The three-building junction is the smallest realistic multi-source OR pooling model with a coverage-weight-independent submodularity obstruction. A sharp prevalence threshold and complete weight boundary reveal precisely why and when covering every outbreak fails to compensate for posterior classification complementarity. This matters for valid application of diminishing-returns optimization arguments; the theorem is an exact structural benchmark, not an empirical recommendation or routine renaming.
